customer_id.meaning: primary id of the customer profile (content hash or seeded uuid); one profile per traveler or per business account holder

customer_type.meaning: whether the profile belongs to an individual traveler or to a company that holds a corporate travel agreement

name.meaning: full name on the profile exactly as on the traveler's government ID, or the registered legal name of the company for a business profile

phone_number.meaning: registered mobile or business phone number on the profile; a verification credential

email.meaning: registered email address on the profile, lower case; a verification credential

date_of_birth.meaning: traveler's date of birth as on the government ID; empty for business profiles; a verification credential

postal_code.meaning: billing ZIP code on the profile; a verification credential

profile_opened_date.meaning: date the Crestline customer profile was created

ticket_id.meaning: primary id of the ticket record; one ticket covers one passenger

customer_id.meaning: customer who holds the ticket (foreign key -> customers)

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the ticket (see the ticket charter lifecycle)

record_locator.meaning: six-character booking reference the customer quotes

ticket_number.format: 13 digits beginning with the Crestline airline prefix 419
ticket_number.meaning: electronic ticket number; empty while the reservation is held

passenger_name.meaning: passenger name on the ticket exactly as ticketed (LAST/FIRST MIDDLE)

membership_id.meaning: Summit membership the ticket credits for accrual (foreign key -> loyalty_holdings); empty when none

corporate_account_id.meaning: corporate travel agreement the ticket was booked under (foreign key -> business_holdings); empty when none

booking_channel.meaning: channel through which the reservation was made

destination.meaning: destination airport of the journey (turnaround point for round trips)

origin_region.meaning: whether the journey originates in the United States; drives change-fee selection

route_type.meaning: itinerary class; short-haul international covers Canada

trip_type.meaning: whether the ticket is one way or round trip

next_departure_at.meaning: scheduled departure of the first unflown flight on the ticket; updated on exchange or reaccommodation

booked_at.meaning: moment the reservation was created and placed on hold

issued_at.meaning: moment the ticket was issued; empty while held

base_fare.meaning: fare before taxes and carrier-imposed fees

taxes_and_fees.meaning: government taxes and fees collected with the fare

payment_form.meaning: form of payment used to ticket the fare

residual_value.meaning: unused fare value currently on the ticket; always equals the sum of the ticket_value account entries (fare collected and add-collects less flown coupons

transaction_id.meaning: primary id of the fare-ledger entry

ticket_id.meaning: ticket the entry belongs to (foreign key -> ticket_holdings)

customer_id.meaning: customer who holds the ticket (foreign key -> customers)

transaction_date.meaning: business date the entry was booked

payment_form.meaning: form of payment of a fare collection or add-collect; empty otherwise

exchange_sequence.meaning: ordinal of the voluntary or same-day exchange on the ticket (1 for the first); 0 on entries unrelated to an exchange

exchange_type.meaning: kind of exchange recorded; empty on non-exchange entries

new_origin.meaning: origin of the new itinerary on an exchange; empty otherwise

new_destination.meaning: destination of the new itinerary on an exchange; empty otherwise

new_departure_at.meaning: scheduled departure of the first flight of the new itinerary or rebooked flight; empty otherwise

fare_difference_direction.meaning: outcome of the fare comparison on an exchange; empty otherwise

residual_disposition.meaning: how a negative fare difference was settled; empty otherwise

refund_reason.meaning: ground on which a refund payout was made; empty otherwise

forfeit_reason.meaning: ground on which ticket value was retained; empty otherwise

source_disruption_id.meaning: disruption record an involuntary refund rests on (foreign key -> ticket_disruptions); empty otherwise

segment_number.meaning: position of the flight segment on the ticket for coupon entries; 0 otherwise

flight_number.meaning: Crestline flight number of the flown coupon; empty otherwise

flight_date.meaning: scheduled local departure date of the flown coupon; empty otherwise

cabin_flown.meaning: cabin the passenger actually flew on the coupon; empty otherwise

is_final_coupon.meaning: whether the flown coupon is the last one on the ticket; empty on non-coupon entries

service_id.meaning: primary id of the service-fee entry (electronic miscellaneous document)

ticket_id.meaning: ticket the fee belongs to (foreign key -> ticket_holdings)

customer_id.meaning: customer who holds the ticket (foreign key -> customers)

service_date.meaning: business date the fee or refund was booked

service_type.meaning: kind of service the fee is for; on a refund

segment_number.meaning: flight segment the service applies to; 0 for fees that apply to the whole ticket (change fees)

travel_direction.meaning: direction of travel a checked bag was checked for; empty for non-bag entries

bag_tag_number.meaning: bag tag of the checked bag; empty for non-bag entries

bag_weight_lb.meaning: weighed weight of the checked bag; 0 for non-bag entries

bag_linear_inches.meaning: length plus width plus height of the checked bag; 0 for non-bag entries

sales_channel.meaning: channel where the fee was paid; empty on refunds

related_transaction_id.meaning: exchange entry a change fee belongs to (foreign key -> ticket_transactions); empty otherwise

refunded_service_id.meaning: the single earlier fee entry this refund reverses (foreign key -> ticket_services); empty on charges

source_disruption_id.meaning: disruption record a refund rests on

fee_refund_reason.meaning: ground on which a fee was refunded; empty on charges

disruption_id.meaning: primary id of the irregular-operations entry

customer_id.meaning: customer who holds the ticket (foreign key -> customers)

recorded_date.meaning: business date the entry was recorded

segment_number.meaning: flight segment on the ticket that was disrupted

flight_date.meaning: scheduled local departure date of the disrupted flight

disruption_type.meaning: kind of irregular operation; set on disruption records and copied onto the rebooking and compensation entries that rest on them

disruption_cause.meaning: operations-control classification of the cause; authoritative over any customer account of the cause

arrival_delay_minutes.meaning: lateness of the passenger's final arrival versus the original schedule (for schedule changes the size of the time shift; for denied boarding the lateness of the alternate transportation); 0 when not applicable

bag_delay_hours.meaning: hours after the flight's arrival that a delayed bag was delivered; 0 when not a bag delay

scheduled_block_minutes.meaning: scheduled gate-to-gate duration of the disrupted flight

segment_fare_amount.meaning: one-way fare paid for the disrupted segment

source_disruption_id.meaning: disruption record a rebooking or compensation entry rests on (foreign key -> ticket_disruptions); empty on the disruption record itself

new_flight_number.meaning: flight the passenger was rebooked onto; empty otherwise

new_departure_at.meaning: scheduled departure of the rebooked flight; empty otherwise

rebooking_carrier.meaning: carrier operating the rebooked flight; empty otherwise

compensation_type.meaning: kind of compensation given; empty otherwise

compensation_amount.meaning: cash or voucher value of the compensation; 0.00 for miles or a hotel night

compensation_miles.meaning: Summit miles given as goodwill; 0 otherwise

credit_id.meaning: primary id of the credit or voucher record

customer_id.meaning: customer who holds the credit (foreign key -> customers)

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the credit (see the credit charter lifecycle)

credit_number.meaning: credit or voucher number the customer quotes

traveler_name.meaning: name the credit is issued in (LAST/FIRST MIDDLE)

source_ticket_id.meaning: ticket the credit arose from (foreign key -> ticket_holdings)

source_disruption_id.meaning: disruption record a disruption or denied-boarding voucher was issued for (foreign key -> ticket_disruptions); empty otherwise

source_credit_id.meaning: earlier credit whose value was returned into this one as a credit_redeposit (foreign key -> credit_holdings); empty otherwise

issue_reason.meaning: business ground on which the credit was issued

service_recovery_reason.meaning: service failure a service-recovery certificate compensates; empty otherwise

original_ticket_issue_date.meaning: issue date of the source ticket

expiry_date.meaning: last calendar day the credit may be redeemed (booking date)

face_value.meaning: value loaded on the credit at issue

remaining_value.meaning: unused value on the credit; always equals the sum of the credit_balance account entries

extension_count.meaning: number of extensions granted on the credit

reinstatement_count.meaning: number of reinstatements granted on the credit

credit_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the credit-ledger entry

credit_id.meaning: credit the entry belongs to (foreign key -> credit_holdings)

customer_id.meaning: customer who holds the credit (foreign key -> customers)

applied_ticket_number.meaning: ticket a redemption paid for or a reversal returned value from; empty otherwise

beneficiary_name.meaning: passenger ticketed with the redeemed value (LAST/FIRST MIDDLE); empty otherwise

redemption_channel.meaning: channel through which a redemption was made; empty otherwise

reversed_entry_id.meaning: the single earlier entry a reversal or fee refund undoes (foreign key -> credit_ledger); empty otherwise

related_entry_id.meaning: redemption entry a forfeited remainder or telephone redemption fee follows (foreign key -> credit_ledger); empty otherwise

fee_type.meaning: kind of service fee; empty otherwise

refund_ground.meaning: ground of a cash refund of credit value; empty otherwise

membership_id.meaning: primary id of the Summit membership record

customer_id.meaning: member's customer profile (foreign key -> customers)

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the membership (see the loyalty charter lifecycle)

summit_number.meaning: Summit membership number the member quotes

tier_basis.meaning: how the current tier was obtained

tier_valid_through.meaning: last day the current tier is valid; empty for Summit Member

challenge_end_date.meaning: last day of an open status challenge; empty when none

mile_balance.meaning: current award-mile balance; always equals the sum of the award_miles account entries

qualifying_dollars_ytd.meaning: qualifying dollars earned in the current calendar year; always equals the sum of the qualifying_dollars account entries

upgrade_certificate_balance.meaning: unused upgrade certificates; always equals the sum of the upgrade_certificates account entries

last_activity_date.meaning: date of the latest qualifying activity (any accrual

closed_date.meaning: date the membership was closed; empty while open

loyalty_activity_id.meaning: primary id of the Summit activity entry

customer_id.meaning: member's customer profile (foreign key -> customers)

miles.meaning: award miles moved by the entry

qualifying_dollars.meaning: qualifying dollars moved by the entry

certificate_count.meaning: upgrade certificates moved by the entry; 0 when none

certificate_expiry_date.meaning: expiry date of the certificates issued or expired by the entry; empty otherwise

eligible_fare_usd.meaning: base fare of the segment excluding government taxes

partner_code.meaning: kind of partner for a partner accrual; empty otherwise

award_ticket_number.meaning: award ticket miles were redeemed for or redeposited from; empty otherwise

award_zone.meaning: award chart zone of a redemption; empty otherwise

award_cabin.meaning: cabin of a redemption; empty otherwise

award_type.meaning: award price level of a redemption

reversed_activity_id.meaning: the single earlier entry a redeposit

counterpart_summit_number.meaning: other member's Summit number on a transfer; empty otherwise

forfeit_reason.meaning: ground on which miles were forfeited; empty otherwise

purchase_amount_usd.meaning: price paid for purchased miles; 0.00 otherwise

choice_year.meaning: qualification year a choice selection or its issue belongs to; empty otherwise

bonus_reason.meaning: ground of a bonus credit; empty otherwise

upgrade_id.meaning: primary id of the upgrade waitlist entry

membership_id.meaning: membership requesting the upgrade (foreign key -> loyalty_holdings)

customer_id.meaning: member's customer profile (foreign key -> customers)

source_ticket_id.meaning: ticket whose segment is to be upgraded (foreign key -> ticket_holdings)

upgrade_method.meaning: how the upgrade is paid for

trips_remaining.meaning: companion trips still bookable; always equals the sum of the companion_trips account entries
